svg.title: D2 — Download stage and confirmation alternatives
svg.desc: Separate alternatives, not concurrent jobs or one terminal screenshot: unknown-total transfer, preparation, cancellation confirmation and safe audio deletion. Non-destructive choice is initially focused.
svg.text: D2 STAGES / SAFE ACTIONS
Alternative snapshots and dialog excerpts — not four simultaneous jobs or a terminal layout
D2a · Downloading — total unknown
The Lantern Atlas · Downloading
[working] 17 MiB received · total unknown
Speed only when measured; no percentage or ETA.
[Cancel download] · current audio is unchanged.
D2b · Preparing — same job, later
The Lantern Atlas · Preparing
[working] Preparing playable audio…
Transfer complete is NOT Ready. No invented %.
[Cancel preparation] · next queued job still waits.
D2c · Cancel Atlas download?
This stops this job, not the current audiobook.
Retry starts again from scratch.
Wait for cleanup before showing Canceled.
> [Keep downloading] [Cancel download]
D2d · Delete Orchard downloaded audio?
Orchard is playing. Stop/checkpoint before delete.
Keep progress, favorites, notes and book metadata.
On stop/checkpoint failure, do not unlink audio.
> [Keep audio] [Stop and delete audio]
Recovery / race outcomes — authoritative result wins
If final publication committed before cancellation, show Ready; never delete the completed book for a late cancel.
If canceled before commit, terminate/reap, clean partials, then show Canceled. Failure to clean up stays inspectable.
Modal input / return
Initially focus Keep. Tab changes buttons; Enter activates the focused choice; Esc backs out without mutation.
Dialogs own keys, including Space; playback continues but its shortcuts do not leak through. Restore origin focus.
